cause: The batched Aseprite pixel operations wrote opaque palette colors at coordinates that were transparent in the frozen baseline. No hard baseline alpha/silhouette mask clipped those writes before the one artistic pass.
remedy: No correction was made because this was a one-attempt benchmark. A future authorized pass must precompute/apply a hard baseline alpha mask and reject any transparent-to-opaque write outside it before visual selection.
selection: failed scope gate; candidate retained as last-attempt evidence only
